architecture_scope_line: Current public desktop scope covers Linux x64 and Windows x64 only. No public route is posted for Windows ARM64, Linux ARM64, and macOS x64 on the current shelf.
claim_boundary_line: Experimental surfaces stay behind lab routes until their visuals, behavior, and tests are ready for normal users.
desktop_pick_line: If you see both desktop apps, start with the Avalonia. Treat Blazor Desktop as a fallback path only when the download page or support explicitly tells you to use it.
fix_availability_summary: Only expect fix notices after the affected download is available on the same public shelf.
known_issue_summary: No blocking release caveat is mirrored, and the downloads page has recent setup, account return, release updates, community wrap-up, offline-ready prefetch, and current support follow-up coverage.
missing_installer_lane_line: Promoted installer coverage is visible on every promised desktop platform.
proof_scope_line: Public pages focus on the builds, platforms, and workflows a player can actually try today; downloads remain the primary route for trying Chummer.
quality_gap_line: Character math is already solid. The rough edges are mostly installer polish, update polish, and support polish.
release_verification_summary: Passed for installs and recovery, campaign session recovery, and support follow-up.
shelf_truth_line: Downloads are currently live for Windows and Linux.
